clinicalPearls: Unilateral nasal mass in adult needs tumour pathway
Angiofibroma: adolescent male, image, embolise, no biopsy
Inverted papilloma recurs and can harbour carcinoma
reference.pathophysiology: HPV associated Schneiderian papilloma inverts into epithelium with local bone resorption, while angiogenesis rich fibrous tumours of adolescence regress or persist with androgen signals; occupational dusts deposit carcinogens on ethmoid mucosa over decades.
additionalDifferentials: Inverted papilloma versus inflammatory polyp (laterality, age, imaging)
Sinonasal cancer versus chronic sinusitis (unilateral red flags)
GPA septal disease versus cocaine lesion (history, systemic features)
additionalInvestigations: Nasendoscopy and biopsy after vascular exclusion
CT and MRI sinuses complementary (bone versus soft tissue)
ANCA, EBV and tissue cultures in midline destruction
